note: Props wave 1 (RICH_STYLE_EXPERIMENT.md, 'The wave this opens', item 2): every prop of the core kit redrawn from itself at 64 px per tile (four times its 16 px size), in the shared ramps of its materials, style rich. Drawn on the free local route, best of three by seed (docs/art/DRAWERS.md): LOCAL_SEED=7, 11 and 13, each into its own folder, e.g. LOCAL_SEED=11 pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/props-wave-1.json --drawer local --out .scratch/kit-gen/props-wave-1-s11 --timeout 900. A sheet gives its first frame only. The galleries are judged by eye; nothing goes into content/ until the picks are made.
